title: Flood Advisory
location: Lincoln, NM; Socorro, NM

details.description:
* WHAT...Arroyo and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...North Central Lincoln County in central New Mexico...
East Central Socorro County in central New Mexico...

* WHEN...Until 900 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas. Some
low-water crossings may become impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 604 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This  will cause arroyo and small stream flooding.
Between 0.5 and 1.5 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of North Central Lincoln and East Central
Socorro Counties.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
details.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

including batteries on handheld radios, for readiness.

details.description:
FFWLZK

The National Weather Service in Little Rock has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern Yell County in central Arkansas...

* Until 945 PM CDT.

* At 635 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses as well as
other poor drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Russellville...                    Danville...
Dardanelle...                      Ola...
Petit Jean River WMA...            Mosley...
Mt Nebo State Park...              Plainview in Yell County...
Lake Dardanelle State Park...      Lake Dardanelle...
Birta...                           Mt George...
Chickalah...                       Centerville...
Ranger...                          Kingston...
Carter Cove Park...                Garden Point Recreation Area...
Spring Lake Campground...
details.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

shelter inside a building or vehicle.

title: Red Flag Warning
location: Central Copper Valley; Southern Copper Valley; McCarthy

details.description:
* Winds...Southeast 15 to 25 mph. Gusts up to 40 mph.

* Timing...Hot, dry, windy conditions this afternoon, persisting
into this evening as temperatures cool by 7pm.

* Relative Humidity...As low as 20 percent.

* Temperatures...In the lower to mid 70s for lower elevations.

* Location...Areas along the Copper and Chitina Rivers.

* Impacts...Rapid ignition, growth and spread of fires will be
possible.
details.instruction:
A red flag warning means that critical fire weather conditions
are imminent or occurring now, or will shortly. It is directed
toward fire agencies, and through them to the public.
